MonitoringProgramDescription: Transient occupancy tax is charged on hotel, motel, and short-term rental stays. Its revenue tracks the visitor economy the Region depends on, and how it shifts with snow years, fire seasons, and the economy.
MonitoringApproach: Each local jurisdiction reports the tax collected in each fiscal year, July through June. El Dorado County's collections are not in the fiscal-year record, so the totals cover the other four jurisdictions.
